{ readonly FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN="$(command -v codex)" &&
case "$FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN" in /*) ;; *) false ;; esac || { echo 'fullsend: codex not found on PATH' >&2; exit 127; }; } &&
readonly FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH="$PATH" &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config, hook adapter or auth script missing or modified; refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } &&
{ [ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config.toml or hooks.json is not the file fullsend wrote; refusing to run (a rewritten config can trust the target repo, which loads its .codex/ layer and its hooks)' >&2; exit 98; }; } &&
command -p rm -f '/sandbox/codex-config/models_cache.json' &&
case "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" in openshell:resolve:env:*OPENAI_API_KEY) ;; *) echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY in the sandbox is not a gateway placeholder (openai provider not attached, or a real key reached the sandbox); refusing to run codex' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac &&
case "$OPENAI_API_KEY" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_:]*) echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY placeholder has unexpected characters; refusing to run codex' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac &&
{ case "${FULLSEND_SEED_PREVIOUS:-}" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_:\ ]*) echo 'fullsend: FULLSEND_SEED_PREVIOUS has unexpected characters; refusing to seed' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac &&
command -p mkdir -p '/sandbox/codex-config' &&
{ command -p flock -w 10 9 &&
{ test -z "${FULLSEND_SEED_PREVIOUS:-}" || { { for fullsend_g in $FULLSEND_SEED_PREVIOUS; do command -p grep -qxF -e "$fullsend_g" '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$fullsend_g"; done; command -p cat '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations' 2>/dev/null || :; } > '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations'.$$ &&
command -p mv -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations'.$$ '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations'; }; } &&
{ fullsend_last=$(command -p tail -n 1 '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations' 2>/dev/null) || :; } &&
if test "$fullsend_last" != "$OPENAI_API_KEY" &&
command -p grep -qxF -e "$OPENAI_API_KEY" '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations' 2>/dev/null; then if { case "$fullsend_last" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_:]*) command -p false ;; openshell:resolve:env:*OPENAI_API_KEY) fullsend_want=$( OPENAI_API_KEY="$fullsend_last"; printf '%s' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ) &&
test -n "$fullsend_want" &&
fullsend_have=$(command -p cat '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token' 2>/dev/null) &&
test "$fullsend_have" = "$fullsend_want" ;; *) command -p false ;; esac; }; then echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY is an older generation than the credential file holds; leaving the file as it is' >&2; else echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY is older than the newest generation in the history, but the credential file does not hold that one; not treating the skipped write as done' >&2; command -p false; fi; else { test "$fullsend_last" = "$OPENAI_API_KEY" || printf '%s\n' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" >> '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations'; } &&
printf '%s' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" > '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend'.$$ &&
command -p mv -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend'.$$ '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token'; fi; } 9>>'/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend-seed.lock' || { command -p rm -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend'.$$ '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.generations'.$$; echo 'fullsend: writing the codex token file failed' >&2; exit 1; }; } &&
{ readonly FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)" &&
case "$FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON" in /*) ;; *) false ;; esac || { echo 'fullsend: python3 not found on PATH' >&2; exit 127; }; } &&
FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS="$("$FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON" -I -S -c 'import os, re, sys
env_file, cap_line, envd_line, restore_line, iter_line, drop_arg = sys.argv[1:7]
drop = set(drop_arg.split())
envd_dir = os.path.dirname(envd_line.split()[3])
iter_file = iter_line.split()[3]
NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*")
values = dict(os.environ)
exported = set(os.environ)
readonly = set()
order = []
failed = []
def warn(path, line, why):
	sys.stderr.write("fullsend: ignored %r line %d: %s\n" % (path, line, why))
def taken(name):
	return name not in drop and name not in readonly
def assign(path, line, name, value):
	if not taken(name):
		warn(path, line, "%s is not taken from .env" % name)
		return
	values[name] = value
	if name not in order:
		order.append(name)
def expand(s, i):
	if s.startswith("{", i):
		m = NAME.match(s, i + 1)
		if not m or not s.startswith("}", m.end()):
			raise ValueError("unsupported parameter expansion")
		return values.get(m.group(), ""), m.end() + 1
	m = NAME.match(s, i)
	if not m:
		raise ValueError("unsupported use of $")
	return values.get(m.group(), ""), m.end()
def value(s, i):
	out = []
	start = i
	while i < len(s):
		c = s[i]
		if c in " \t\n":
			break
		if c == "~" and (i == start or s[i - 1] == ":"):
			if i + 1 < len(s) and s[i + 1] not in "/: \t\n":
				raise ValueError("unsupported ~user")
			out.append(values.get("HOME", ""))
			i += 1
		elif c == "'\''":
			j = s.find("'\''", i + 1)
			if j < 0:
				raise ValueError("unterminated quote")
			out.append(s[i + 1:j])
			i = j + 1
		elif c == "\"":
			i += 1
			while True:
				if i >= len(s):
					raise ValueError("unterminated quote")
				c = s[i]
				if c == "\"":
					i += 1
					break
				if c == "\\" and i + 1 < len(s) and s[i + 1] in "$\"\\\x60\n":
					if s[i + 1] != "\n":
						out.append(s[i + 1])
					i += 2
				elif c == "$":
					v, i = expand(s, i + 1)
					out.append(v)
				elif c == "\x60":
					raise ValueError("command substitution")
				else:
					out.append(c)
					i += 1
		elif c == "$":
			v, i = expand(s, i + 1)
			out.append(v)
		elif c == "\\":
			if i + 1 >= len(s) or s[i + 1] == "\n":
				raise ValueError("line continuation")
			out.append(s[i + 1])
			i += 2
		elif c in ";&|<>()\x60":
			raise ValueError("not a plain assignment")
		else:
			out.append(c)
			i += 1
	return "".join(out), i
def end_of_statement(s, i):
	while i < len(s) and s[i] in " \t":
		i += 1
	if i < len(s) and s[i] == "#":
		i = s.find("\n", i)
		i = len(s) if i < 0 else i
	if i < len(s) and s[i] != "\n":
		raise ValueError("trailing text after the assignment")
	return i
def statement(path, line, s, i, eol):
	j = i
	export = False
	if s.startswith("export", j) and j + 6 < len(s) and s[j + 6] in " \t":
		export = True
		j += 6
		while j < len(s) and s[j] in " \t":
			j += 1
	m = NAME.match(s, j)
	if not m:
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	name = m.group()
	j = m.end()
	if j < len(s) and s[j] == "=":
		v, j = value(s, j + 1)
		j = end_of_statement(s, j)
		assign(path, line, name, v)
		if export and taken(name):
			exported.add(name)
		return j
	if not export:
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	names = s[i:eol].split()[1:]
	if not all(NAME.fullmatch(n) for n in names):
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	for n in names:
		if taken(n):
			exported.add(n)
			if n in values and n not in order:
				order.append(n)
	return eol
def read_file(path, control):
	try:
		with open(path, encoding=sys.getfilesystemencoding(), errors="surrogateescape") as f:
			s = f.read()
	except OSError as e:
		return e
	i = 0
	while i < len(s):
		while i < len(s) and s[i] in " \t\n":
			i += 1
		if i >= len(s):
			break
		line = s.count("\n", 0, i) + 1
		eol = s.find("\n", i)
		eol = len(s) if eol < 0 else eol
		text = s[i:eol].rstrip(" \t")
		if text.startswith("#"):
			pass
		elif control and text == cap_line:
			if "FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH" not in readonly:
				assign(path, line, "FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH", values.get("PATH", ""))
				readonly.add("FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH")
		elif control and text == envd_line:
			try:
				names = sorted(os.listdir(envd_dir))
			except OSError:
				names = []
			for n in names:
				p = os.path.join(envd_dir, n)
				if n.endswith(".env") and not n.startswith(".") and os.path.isfile(p):
					e = read_file(p, False)
					if e is not None:
						failed.append((p, e))
		elif control and text == restore_line:
			now = values.get("PATH", "")
			assign(path, line, "PATH", values.get("FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH", "") + (":" + now if now else ""))
			exported.add("PATH")
		elif control and text == iter_line:
			if os.path.isfile(iter_file):
				e = read_file(iter_file, False)
				if e is not None:
					failed.append((iter_file, e))
		else:
			try:
				eol = statement(path, line, s, i, eol)
			except ValueError as e:
				warn(path, line, str(e))
		i = eol
	return None
err = read_file(env_file, True)
if err is not None:
	failed.insert(0, (env_file, err))
for path, e in failed:
	sys.stderr.write("fullsend: cannot read %r: %s\n" % (path, e.strerror))
if failed:
	sys.exit(1)
for n in order:
	if n in exported and n in values and "\0" not in values[n]:
		sys.stdout.buffer.write(os.fsencode("export %s='\''%s'\''\n" % (n, values[n].replace("'\''", "'\''\\'\'''\''"))))
' '/sandbox/workspace/.env' 'if ( FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH= ) 2>/dev/null; then FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH="$PATH"; readonly FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH; fi' 'for f in /sandbox/workspace/.env.d/*.env; do [ -f "$f" ] &&
. "$f"; done' 'export PATH="$FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH${PATH:+:$PATH}"' 'if [ -f /sandbox/workspace/.fullsend/iteration.env ]; then . /sandbox/workspace/.fullsend/iteration.env; fi' 'LD_PRELOAD LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_AUDIT PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONSTARTUP PYTHONUSERBASE IFS FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH')" &&
eval "$FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS" &&
unset FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS &&
export CODEX_HOME=/sandbox/codex-config &&
export PATH="$FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH" &&
export FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH &&
export FULLSEND_RUNTIME=codex &&
unset OPENAI_BASE_URL OPENAI_API_KEY CODEX_API_KEY NODE_OPTIONS NODE_PATH PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONSTARTUP LD_PRELOAD LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_AUDIT &&
unset -f test command grep cut wc sha256sum printf codex &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config, hook adapter or auth script missing or modified; refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } &&
{ [ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config.toml or hooks.json is not the file fullsend wrote; refusing to run (a rewritten config can trust the target repo, which loads its .codex/ layer and its hooks)' >&2; exit 98; }; } &&
command -p rm -f '/sandbox/codex-config/models_cache.json' &&
printf '%s' 'Run the agent task' | "$FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN" exec --json --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -C '/sandbox/workspace/repo' --model 'gpt-5.6-luna' -c 'model_provider=fullsend-openai' -c 'approval_policy=never' -c 'sandbox_mode=danger-full-access' -c 'model_providers.fullsend-openai.base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1"' -c 'model_providers.fullsend-openai.auth.command="/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh"' -o '/sandbox/codex-config/last-message.txt' -
